title: Studio 作者面板上的开发者用语和机器名：关联字段提示、校验提示标题、通知节点说明、设置键名（一张合并卡）
body:
repo:objectstack#1 · os-warren · session_01JQwxbZeHNsF3RWcWpj7rGj

① product defect · Source: maintainer (Warren), 2026-11-23, UI review thread.
- 14:23Z 「还有哪些元数据可能会有问题？同时全面的测试 studio的各项功能」
- 15:09Z 「用fable 评审一下 studio的问题，提出修改方案」
- 15:23Z, decision card 「Studio 评审的 9 张卡，按 fable 方案立卡吗？」 → **「9 张全立」**

Evidence:
- Fable code review on main 9e0c0c23: project file `ui-review-2026-11-23/fable-studio-review.md`.
- Browser screenshots: `ui-review-2026-11-23/round2/`.
- Round-2 report: https://claude.ai/artifact/X5ukNAgphAq5vDpDAT6SAD

Paths are relative to `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/` unless they start with `ui/` or `packages/`. `SDS` = `studio-design/StudioDesignSurface.tsx`. `zh` = `ui/packages/i18n/src/namespaces/studio/zh.ts`. Line numbers are on 9e0c0c23.

One family card: developer wording and machine names on Studio author panels. The zh `label` wording card filed beside this one is also copy, and the two may share one PR.

## What and expected, by location

**r08: Lookup 「关联对象」 placeholder and hints.**
- `metadata-admin/inspectors/ObjectFieldInspector.tsx:1774`: the placeholder is `object_name` (`zh:361`), in monospace with no chevron, so it looks like a text box. The list does open on focus (`ObjectPicker.tsx:514–519`). Change it to a human placeholder, 「选择对象…」, and add a chevron.
- `ObjectFieldInspector.tsx:2933` passes `reference`, the API name, into 「所有 {ref} 记录均可选」, and falls back to the hard-coded English `'related'`. Resolve `{ref}` to the object's label from the catalog the picker already reads.
- Before a target is set, the related-list help falls back to 「父对象」 (`ObjectFieldInspector.tsx:3213`, `zh:396`), which gives 「在 父对象 记录页上」. Do not render the two hints until a target is set; `designer.field.lookup.setTargetFirst` exists at `zh:367`.

**r09: the lint toast head.**
- `ui/packages/app-shell/src/providers/saveAdvisoryToast.ts:107–111` prefixes every finding with `[rule] where`. `where` is the developer locator in English (`packages/lint/src/validate-security-posture.ts:1614`), even when the producer sent a sentence written for the author.
- When `userMessage` is present, show the sentence alone. Keep `[rule] where` only on the developer face.
- Out of scope: naming objects and permission sets by label inside the sentence. That needs producer-side label lookup, a new capability (review F3), which waits on the maintainer's pick. See also #32654.

**r10: the Notify node inspector.**
- The zh overlay at `metadata-admin/i18n.ts:576–590` carries developer text: 「通知标题(别名:subject)」, 「通知正文(别名:body)」, 「事件主题(默认 "notify")」, 「引发该事件的用户 id」, 「通知所关联记录的对象名」, 「info | warning | critical」.
- The English base still says "Event topic (default: "notify")" (`metadata-admin/inspectors/flow-node-config.ts:1284`).
- Rewrite the rows in the author's words, in the English base and every locale overlay. Topic, Triggering user and Payload may go behind the existing 「Advanced」 fold, in this card.

**r11: setting keys on the object 「设置」 panel.** This was ruled by the maintainer at 15:23Z: the key stays off the panel at rest and shows on hover.
- `SettingKey` draws the metadata key as a chip beside every title (`studio-design/ObjectSettingsPanel.tsx:152–169, 171–183`, nine uses).
- Move the key into the title's hover text, after the pickers' `nameOnHover` precedent (`ObjectPicker.tsx:281–286`).
- This supersedes the "key as a small chip beside the title" choice from #36512 (closed). Update that file's comment to cite this card.

## Acceptance
- One test per location pins the new text or behaviour:
  - the Lookup placeholder and label-resolved hint, with no hint before a target is set;
  - the toast without `[rule] where` when `userMessage` is present;
  - the Notify rows in en and zh;
  - the setting key in hover text and not on the panel.
- Browser screenshots of each panel in zh.

Grading: `area:ux` · Bug · Cosmetic · builders and administrators, often ⇒ p2. Effort M. Evidence: read (review r08–r11) + measured (`round2/` r08–r11).

Dedupe: no open card names `SettingKey`, `saveAdvisoryToast`'s head, or the Notify inspector's zh rows. #32654 is the producer-side tracking card for user-facing text, and this card does not touch producers.
